> StreamPixel is a 3-foot RGB pixel display built mainly for music. It connects to Spotify to show the current song, artist and playback progress, then switches to pixel animations when nothing is playing. I’ll also build a companion app where I can choose animations, display custom text and pixel art, adjust brightness and control what appears on the screen.
